senses.gloss: m.(b. h. סְדָרִים pl.; סָדַר) row, pile, arrangement, order, succession.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>ו׳ חלות לס׳ זה וכ׳</he> six cakes in one pile and six in the other.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:7">Yoma V, 7</cite> <he>כל … האמור על הס׳ וכ׳</he> as to all the acts for the Day of Atonement here told in their consecutive order, if he advanced (changed the order) &c. Sifra Tsav, Mill. <he>הסדיר את הקרבנות כסִידְרָן</he> the text arranges the sacrificial functions in their proper succession.
<cite ref="Yoma 73a:17">Yoma 73ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>דוד שאל שלא כס׳</he> David did not put his questions (<cite ref="I Samuel 23:11">I Sam. XXIII, 11</cite>) in their natural order.

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 3:4">Meg. III, 4</cite> <he>חוזרין לכסִדְרָן</he> the regular reading (interrupted during the four distinguished Sabbaths, v. <cite ref="Q02033"><he>פָּרָשָׁה</he></cite>) is resumed. Ib. 30ᵇ <he>לס׳ פרשיות הוא חוזר</he> the regular order of the Pentateuch sections is resumed; <he>לס׳ הפטרות וכ׳</he> the regular order of Haftaroth is resumed; a. v. fr.—<he>ס׳ זרעים</he> the Order of Seeds, the first Order of the Mishnah; <he>ס׳ מועד</he> the Order of Festivals, the second Order of the Mishnah &c.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:2">Esth. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>ראש הס׳</he> as the first words of a pericope (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:7">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> <he>ראש סדרא</he>).—Pl. <he>סְדָרִים</he>, constr. <he>סִדְרֵי</he>, <cite ref="O00067"><he>סִי׳</he></cite>.—<he>סדרי משנה</he>, v. <cite ref="M02941"><he>מִשְׁנָה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:23">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ חכמה</he> orders (rules) of wisdom; <he>ס׳ נשיאות</he> rules for the conduct of the Nasi’s office.
Sabb. 53ᵇ ס׳ בראשית the order of nature; a. fr.—Esp. regular homilies on the weekly portion.

<cite ref="Sotah 49a:8">Sot. 49ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 10:22">Job X, 22</cite>) <he>אם יש סדרים תופיע וכ׳</he> but if regular homilies are held, it (the earth) will come forth bright out of the dark.
